title: MSI (Windows Installer) signature
summary: An MSI file is an OLE2 compound document with the CLSID {000C1084-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}. The OLE2 signature (D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1) is followed by a specific CLSID in the header.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

ext.magic_hex: D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1
notes: MSI files are OLE2 compound documents containing installation databases.
MSI supports transactions, rollback, and patching.
